topics.topic: AuditEntry creation and confirmation retention for accepted no-op actions
questions: Does a confirmed action that succeeds by returning an already archived or already anonymised project unchanged create an AuditEntry and retain its confirmation id?
Does an accepted action that returns an already archived, anonymised or erased record unchanged create an AuditEntry?

judgement.why: This asks the same question as P1 about audit entries and confirmation ids for accepted unchanged confirmed actions, and the relevant passages have not changed.

precedent.topic: Whether unchanged confirmed actions receive confirmation ids and audit entries
quotes:
the outcome (accepted; whether refused attempts are recorded is settled in
  State 2, round 28 P1);

Which actions must state
the revision they were made against is State 2's (carried, R0-35).
precedent.why: Whether a confirmed invocation is accepted, refused, treated as a no-op, and consequently emits an audit entry or confirmation id is an operation rule owned by State 2.

topics.topic: Publisher attribution carried by an imported ArtifactPointer
questions: What publisher fact does an imported ArtifactPointer carry: an ActingPrincipal, a MigrationClosure, no publisher, or a provenance value that can contain either?
What publisher fact does an imported ArtifactPointer carry: an ActingPrincipal, a MigrationClosure reference, or no publisher attribution?

quotes: written once: the instant it was published and by which principal (M07) — a producer service as its token names it, Kernel for the agent naming its session, or the owner for any owner service; the instant it was superseded; the instant it was withdrawn and by which principal (R0-14).
Its publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a principal — and its published and superseded instants are those the source holds ("Revisions and times").
judgement.why: The first passage requires every pointer's publisher to be an ActingPrincipal, while the second assigns an imported pointer a MigrationClosure that is explicitly not a principal.

topics.topic: AuditEntry creation and outcomes for refused attempts
questions: Can a refused attempt create an AuditEntry even though it causes no accepted state change, and if so which refused actions are included and what outcomes may the model carry?

topics.topic: AuditEntry creation for successful agent-authority reads
questions: Does any successful agent-authority read create an AuditEntry, or are all reads excluded as R0-58 and the action list state?

topics.topic: AuditEntry identity: sequence number or separate UUID
questions: Is the ordinal sequence number the AuditEntry’s identity and an explicit exception to the UUID identity rule, or does an AuditEntry also need a UUID identity distinct from its ordering sequence?
Are the project-card, context and agent-projection definitions limited to non-anonymised projects, with an anonymised project returning only the erased answer?
